Milk Specialties Company.event: The company corporate rebranded and changed its name to Actus Nutrition
Milk Specialties Company.evidence: In October 2024, Milk Specialties Global officially rebranded and changed its name to Actus Nutrition to better align with its expanded health and wellness ingredient offerings. Under its NutriPRO line, the company continues to actively manufacture and supply lactoferrin ingredients derived from dairy processing.
